title: stories
description: Reproducible native UI component stories, fixture models and semantic recipes.

id.description: Project-unique asset ID of this document.

versions.description: Stored version of each type newer than version 1.

records.description: Records keyed by ID. The ID prefix selects the record type.

InputMode.description: Input device used by a story's activation recipe.

oneOf.description: Primary pointer hover, press and release.

Locale.description: An explicit translation pack with optional pseudo expansion and layout mirroring.

rtl.description: Mirror layout boxes while preserving glyph direction and logical reading order.

pseudo.description: Apply accent substitution and 35 percent expansion after resolving messages.

messages.description: Translation keys and complete localized strings.

Query.description: A visible semantic query; ambiguity is an error rather than an arbitrary first match.

value.description: Exact role, localized label/text or test ID.

name.description: Optional accessible name, used to distinguish controls with the same role.

oneOf.description: Accessible role, using names such as `button`, `textbox`, `checkbox` and `dialog`.
Explicit `test-id` attribute, falling back to the stable authored ID.

StepKind.description: Operations supported by the data-only story test runner.

oneOf.description: Require exactly one visible semantic match.
Focus a target through the native scope manager.
Require that the target owns native focus.
Activate via the view's pointer, keyboard or controller mode.
Insert text through the native text editing seam.
Assert a committed native control value.
Assert current visible text, resolving `loc:key` expectations.
Assert selector states from a `{ "hover": true }` object on the queried control.
Require a named emitted gameplay action.
Advance the deterministic UI clock by `value` milliseconds.

Story.description: An isolated component example, serialized as an `st_` record.

component.description: Component or screen being demonstrated, using `@path#id` for external assets.

markup.description: Original native markup, including optional component templates.

stylesheet.description: Token-only stylesheet appended to Ara's standard theme rules.

fixtureType.description: Registered schema type of the fixture model.

fixture.description: Immutable model values used to initialize `bind` destinations.

locales.description: Explicit locale packs; every `loc:key` must be present.

views.description: Representative captures, with all dimensions explicit rather than an implicit host default.

transitions.description: Deterministic translation tracks sampled at each view's animation time.

images.description: Self-contained decoded image fixtures; production hosts can supply their own resources.

steps.description: Reproducible semantic interactions and assertions, executed after the initial capture.

StoryImage.description: Decoded RGBA8 image fixture, resolved by the same source handle as runtime images.

rgba.description: Straight-alpha RGBA8 pixels in row order.

StoryStep.description: One declarative action or assertion in a component story.

kind.description: Operation to execute through the production input seam.

query.description: Target control; unused by time and named-action assertions.

value.description: Expected value, inserted text, action name or elapsed milliseconds, according to kind.

StoryView.description: One fixed native preview configuration; dimensions are logical pixels and DPI is pixels/inch.

dpi.description: Physical scale; 96 means one physical pixel per logical pixel.

locale.description: Locale pack identifier from the story.

input.description: Device used by semantic activation steps and action prompts.

timeMs.description: Absolute deterministic UI animation time, in milliseconds.

Transition.description: A deterministic paint translation; never changes gameplay state or the wall clock.

from.description: Translation at the start time, in logical pixels.

to.description: Translation at the end time, in logical pixels.

durationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds; zero is an immediate change.
